infile.scope: Open the required MeasurementSet for sky and Tsys generation and application. Handle complex DATA or float total-power input.

calmode.scope: Generate PS, OTF, raster and spectral Tsys calibration and apply existing or composite tables.

fraction.scope: Interpret numeric and percent forms and select raster strip or OTF map edges.

noff.scope: Select an explicit count at each raster strip end and retain CASA fraction validation.

width.scope: Accept CASA width values. The pinned task selects OTF edges with its fixed projection scale.

elongated.scope: Accept the elongated flag. The pinned task uses the same OTF boundary algorithm for both values.

applytable.scope: Read a path or path list with sky, spectral Tsys and Jy/K calibration and apply the terms in CASA calibration order.

interp.scope: Interpolate reference spectra in time and frequency with distinct signal and exposure-weight laws.

spwmap.scope: Map science windows to Tsys windows using a flat list or ordered source-to-target dictionary.

outfile.scope: Publish standard CASA-readable generation products. Applications update CORRECTED_DATA in the input MeasurementSet.

overwrite.scope: Replace a generated table with explicit consent while protecting locked outputs and MeasurementSet subtables.

field.scope: Select reference and science fields. Tsys uses the whole observation when generating a composite prior.

spw.scope: Select reference windows and science channels. Direct Tsys generation requires the all-window form.

scan.scope: Select scan rows for sky generation and application. Direct Tsys generation requires the all-scan form.

intent.scope: Select observing intents for sky-table generation. Direct apply and Tsys generation keep the keyword inactive. The OTF and raster composites with Tsys use the local on-source selection.

behaviors.title: Position-switch sky spectra
behaviors.scope: Group OFF integrations by observing metadata, average each unflagged cell by exposure, and publish CASA-compatible times, flags, weights and solution shape.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale performance validation follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: System-temperature calibration
behaviors.scope: Generate spectral Tsys tables through the shared calibration path, including observing scan assignment and canonical calibration subtables.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale performance validation follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Sky calibration application
behaviors.scope: Apply sky, spectral Tsys and Jy/K calibration, including PS, OTF and raster composites, exposure weights, ordered SPW maps and interpolation.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale performance validation follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: OTF and raster sky calibration
behaviors.scope: Select time-separated raster strip edges or the spatial OTF map boundary with measured antenna pointings and moving-body offsets.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale performance validation follows functionality under #979.

decisions.inputs: A sky calibration table with a clear flag and a zero OFF reference spectrum.
decisions.casa: Divides by the zero spectrum and leaves the channel unflagged.
decisions.ours: Retains the value entering the sky correction and flags the invalid sample in flag-writing modes.
decisions.rationale: The OFF spectrum is the denominator of the correction and cannot define a finite calibrated value at zero.
decisions.impact: Adjacent channels with valid references still calibrate and downstream consumers can mask the invalid correction.

decisions.inputs: A gapped raster map with multiple strips and valid reference integrations at both ends of each strip.
decisions.casa: Depending on uninitialized gap-array contents, can omit the two solutions from the last strip.
decisions.ours: Always close the final range at the integration count and select both ends of the last strip.
decisions.rationale: The last observed strip has the same edge eligibility as preceding strips. Including both boundaries produces stable calibration across repeat runs.
decisions.impact: All 44 reference spectra from the 22-strip fixture are present.

generation.kind: Same-input CASA and native calibration tables
generation.scope: Public position-switch and Tsys generation with float and complex data, unequal exposures, channel and scan selection, single-polarization padding and publication protections.
generation.result: Native and CASA tables agreed in the paired cases, including unused SPW flags and moving-field Tsys metadata.

application.kind: Paired public-Python CASA/native application plus 2x2 calibration-table interchange
application.scope: Direct and PS/Tsys composite application, DATA and FLOAT_DATA, mapped Tsys and Jy/K, exposure weighting and nonlinear frequency resampling.
application.result: Corrected visibilities, flags, scalar and spectral weights and float scratch units agree across both writers and readers. Irregular exposure and a distinct Tsys window give independent physical expectations. The zero-reference decision has its own executable comparison.

edges.kind: Public CASA/native OTF and raster edge comparisons, analytic raster counts and table interchange
edges.scope: Temporal raster strips, spatial OTF masks, pointing interpolation, flags, selected windows and scans, and moving Solar System targets.
edges.result: Native and CASA reference spectra, times, flags, application outputs and weights agree in the paired workflows. The upstream Mars fixture and a synthetic topocentric Moon map exercise moving-source offsets.

intent.kind: Installed CASA keyword and selected position-switch output
intent.scope: The public wrapper forwards the text keyword through its generated schema. A tagged OFF group separates the selected scans from the default result.
intent.result: Pinned CASA generated scans 1 and 3 with the default and scan 1 with the selected intent. The baseline native wrapper refused the keyword. Candidate native validation is pending.
